summary: Iter 81 - Planning consultations médecins module validated. Backend: 27/27 pytest PASS (11 new planning tests + 16 regression). Frontend E2E confirms planning page, admin webhook section, sidebar filtering. TWO functional bugs found on medecin view due to wrong /me endpoint call.

ui_bugs.issue: fetchMe calls apiClient.get('/me') which returns 404 (correct endpoint is '/auth/me'). Because 'me' stays null, isMedecin=false for the tracked-role Médecin user → the [data-testid='planning-medecin-lock-badge'] is NOT rendered, and [data-testid='planning-doctor-filter'] is NOT disabled. Backend appointment filtering still works correctly (server-side lock via medecin_id_locked), so the 4 seeded appointments still show up. Only the visual lock affordances are broken.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/me returns 404 (endpoint does not exist). Frontend expects /api/auth/me. Fix: replace apiClient.get('/me') by apiClient.get('/auth/me') in Planning.jsx line ~96.

medecin_view.planning-now-indicator: ABSENT — expected since current UTC ~05:30 is outside 08h-20h grid window (per note, acceptable)
medecin_view.sidebar: Only 'Planning consultations' link (no other menu links) ✓

admin_view.doctor_filter_options: Only ['— Tous les médecins —'] — 'Dr. Aissata Ouedraogo' NOT in dropdown (needs investigation: possibly because tracked-role users are excluded from /me/planning/doctors, or the endpoint returns doctors keyed on different criterion). Backend test test_list_doctors_returns_medecin PASS locally, so likely a tenant/permission scope issue for super-admin view.

action_items: FIX Planning.jsx (portal) line ~96: change apiClient.get('/me') to apiClient.get('/auth/me') so that isMedecin flag becomes true for tracked-role Médecin users. This will restore the lock badge (data-testid='planning-medecin-lock-badge') and disable the doctor filter select.

INVESTIGATE super-admin doctor filter dropdown: /me/planning/doctors returns doctors on backend pytest but the admin dropdown only shows the placeholder option '— Tous les médecins —'. Verify tenant/parent_client_id scoping when the caller is super-admin (id != tenant of seeded medecin). May need to broaden the query for admin roles.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest fully green. Two frontend bugs remain: (1) Planning.jsx /me → /auth/me fix, (2) super-admin doctor filter dropdown empty. Verify_otp endpoint requires session_token from login response — not just email+code. Frontend token key is 'sawali_token' in localStorage.
rca_of_the_issue: Planning.jsx fetchMe uses apiClient.get('/me'). Since baseURL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+'/api', the resolved URL is /api/me which returns 404 (correct FastAPI route is /api/auth/me). apiClient error handler swallows it, so me stays null → isMedecin computed as (me?.tracked_role) === 'Médecin' is false → conditional UI (lock badge, disabled select) never renders for medecin user. Backend security is unaffected because /me/planning/appointments locks medecin_id server-side.
